# Vid's input layer, copied into PSE Triglav

Copied on 18 October 2026 from `zeravatechnologies/vid`, commit `49020b9`,
directory `src/vid/input_layer/` and the `[input_layer]` section of
`src/vid/defaults.toml`. The only changes: imports point at
`triglav.vendor.vid_input`, and the settings are read from the copy here.
Triglav does not pull anything from the Vid repository at run time.
